name: Shandong Boan Biotechnology Co., Ltd.
summary: Shandong Boan Biotechnology Co., Ltd. is a biopharmaceutical company, founded in 2013 and headquartered in Yantai, that develops, manufactures and commercializes therapeutic antibodies. It reports mainland China and other countries as geographic segments, and concentrates on oncology, metabolism, autoimmunity and ophthalmology.
